title: Occassional crash when selecting node to add via "Create New Node" dialogue
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4.beta3, 4.4.beta2, 4.4.beta1, 4.4.dev7
- Not reproducible in: 4.3-stable, 4.4.dev1, 4.4.dev4, 4.4.dev5, 4.4.dev6

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - macOS Sequoia (15.1.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M1 Pro - Apple M1 Pro (10 threads)

### Issue description

Sometimes, when trying to add a new node via "Create New Node" dialog (opened with CMD+A) the editor just crashes.

Sometimes this happens again after several minutes, sometimes there are hours between the crashes.

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project
- open `test.gd`
- Edit the class_name to sth. different
- add node in the scene explorer and search for the changed name
